entities.name: O67879
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Aquifex aeolicus methylthioribose-1-phosphate isomerase.
Catalyzes interconversion of methylthioribose-1-phosphate (MTR-1-P) and methylthioribulose-1-phosphate (MTRu-1-P).
Annotated to methionine salvage pathway, step 1/6; GO:0046523.

entities.name: Methionine salvage
observations: The exact-match protein is annotated to L-methionine biosynthesis via the salvage pathway, converting MTR-1-P to MTRu-1-P at step 1/6.
